- We can accept a SOC2 evidence bundle in advance (SFTP or Drive link). Ill send the secure upload instructions after we pick a slot.
- 30 minutes is doable for a focused run-through, but given the DPA/pen overlap we recommend 45 minutes to leave time for the vendor pen-test scope question.

Slot compatibility for our team: Wed 6/30 16:00 PT conflicts with a pen-test dry run on our side. Thu 7/1 09:00 PT is free for the Red team (Olga + Ben) but Laura would be in customer meetings. Fri 7/2 11:00 PT is free but would push into Finora's midday.

Proposal: take Thu 7/1 09:00 PT as the primary, and keep Fri 7/2 11:00 PT as a backup. If Finora strongly prefers an evening slot, we can explore Thu 7/1 19:00 PT (Olga + rotating on-call engineer) but that would be a compact 30-min session.

I've attached a short agenda and an evidence matrix template to speed the prep.

Olga
